subject: [hw] lead review IP: after a guest stop the daemon must EXIT (launchd restarts it), not keep serving
body: daemon/vcodecd.c: "tears the session down ... and keeps serving" is unsafe for N2A32_STOP_FAULT and pointless for the other guest stops: (1) the core turns a host SIGSEGV into a stop with siglongjmp (emu/n2a32_core.c fault_handler); when the fault happened inside a host shim (memcpy/heap/stdio on a bad guest pointer) the jump leaves that shim s host mutexes locked and its data half-updated; (2) the hosted vpud thread is dead after any stop and n2vhost refuses a second set per process, so no later session can work anyway. Required: on any guest stop (n2vhost_join(h,0)==0) or n2shim thread failure: answer the pending request with N2VCD_E_GUEST + detail, send N2VCD_ERROR to the other clients, power the blocks off (best effort, bounded), log one "N2VCD fatal guest stop <reason> pc=<addr> <n2elf_describe>" line, then _exit(70). opus-ios: the launchd plist needs KeepAlive (restart after exit 70) with ThrottleInterval >= 5 s; clients (P03/P04) must treat E_GUEST / a vanished server as "fall back to software for this session and retry connect at the next StartSession". Hardware timeouts (E_HW) may keep serving. Add to the host test: fake vhost reports a guest stop -> the daemon process exits with 70 after replying. Second item: use RWVC_DMA_INFO as approved (header rev 2).
